name: cospace-monorepo
description: CoSpace - Production-Ready Coworking Space Booking and Management Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n "ADMIN-FE,ADMIN-BE,CLIENT-FE,CLIENT-BE" -c "blue,cyan,green,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix Admin/Frontend" "npm run dev --prefix Admin/Backend" "npm run dev --prefix Client/Frontend" "npm run dev --prefix Client/Backend"
scripts.dev:share: concurrently --kill-others -n "ADMIN-FE,ADMIN-BE,CLIENT-FE,CLIENT-BE,CLOUDFLARE" -c "blue,cyan,green,yellow,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix Admin/Frontend" "npm run dev --prefix Admin/Backend" "npm run dev --prefix Client/Frontend" "npm run dev --prefix Client/Backend" "node scripts/cloudflare-tunnel.js client"
scripts.dev:admin: concurrently --kill-others -n "ADMIN-FE,ADMIN-BE" -c "blue,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix Admin/Frontend" "npm run dev --prefix Admin/Backend"
scripts.dev:client: concurrently --kill-others -n "CLIENT-FE,CLIENT-BE" -c "green,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix Client/Frontend" "npm run dev --prefix Client/Backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix Admin/Frontend && npm run build --prefix Admin/Backend && npm run build --prefix Client/Frontend && npm run build --prefix Client/Backend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix Admin/Backend && npm run test --prefix Client/Backend

author: CoSpace Engineering Team
